decisions.reason: Chart visualization has become a standard feature in the core platform, making the standalone plugin redundant and not worth separate marketing.
This plugin was only briefly mentioned in 2018 and has not been observed since, indicating low adoption and little strategic value.
Mobile layer control is now integrated into standard mobile map interfaces, so the separate component can be retired without losing functionality.
Mobile field data capture addresses a core enterprise need and may still generate revenue through solution sales even if not separately showcased.
Search extensions are now built into web map apps, and the standalone product has had no visible presence since 2018.
